title: Mike McConnell linked to S4/Area 51 via Dan Burisch story

tellings.quote: I think he might have been talking about a guy named Mike McConnell, who became NSA director later. But he was involved in some S4 Area 51 stuff related to Dan Burisch, whose story I think honestly holds up a lot less than your story.

plain: Mike McConnell, who later became director of the NSA, the US eavesdropping agency, was involved in secret work at S4, a site near Area 51 in Nevada where alien craft are said to be studied, according to the story of a man named Dan Burisch who claims to have worked there. Michels says this to Bob Lazar, the man who says he worked on alien craft at S4, guessing that the pilot John Lear may have been talking about McConnell. Michels adds that he thinks Burisch's story "holds up a lot less" than Lazar's.
